# thriftedBD

> thriftedBD is an online thrift store in Bangladesh selling quality-checked, imported preloved (secondhand) fashion sourced from Korea, Japan, Taiwan and China. Every item is a unique, one-of-a-kind piece with single-quantity stock. Payment is cash on delivery (COD) nationwide, with bKash/Nagad accepted for advance payments.

## About

- Product range: women's and men's tops, bottoms (including palazzos), dresses, bags and backpacks, and other preloved apparel and accessories.
- Inventory model: each product is unique with 0 or 1 in stock — once sold, it's gone.
- Quality: every piece is inspected and quality-checked before it is listed.
- Delivery & payment: cash on delivery across Bangladesh; advance payment via bKash/Nagad may be required for some orders.
- Language: the site is in English.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://thriftedbd.com): featured collections and new arrivals.
- [Shop all products](https://thriftedbd.com/products): the full catalogue with category and filter navigation.
- [Track your order](https://thriftedbd.com/track-order): look up an order by phone number and order number.
- [Returns](https://thriftedbd.com/returns): return and exchange policy.
- [Contact](https://thriftedbd.com/contact): customer support and business contact details.

## Notes

- Product, category, and listing pages carry structured data (Product / ItemList / BreadcrumbList schema) for reliable fact extraction.
- Prices are in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT).
